TextView.android:text: A secure, offline password manager for Android. Generate deterministic passwords from secret phrases without storing them.\n\nYour secret phrases and passwords are NEVER stored anywhere!

• Password Generator: SHA-256 based
• Private key: 15-30 iterations
• Public key: 45-60 iterations
• Password length: 12-100 characters
• Secret phrase: minimum 12 characters
• Storage: Only public keys are saved

Passwords generated on any platform (Python, JavaScript, Kotlin, Go, C#, Web, Desktop, CLI and others) will be IDENTICAL when using the same secret phrase and length!

✓ Same algorithm across all implementations
✓ Fully deterministic generation
✓ No cloud dependency
✓ Complete platform independence
